meta.name: SIRENE
meta.brief: Faixas e palavras gritadas em uma torre estreita de LED, como sinal de rua à noite.

contract.concept: Faixas e palavras gritadas em uma torre estreita de LED, como sinal de rua à noite.
contract.audienceEffect: The audience should feel Faixas e palavras gritadas em uma torre estreita de LED, como sinal de rua à noite.
contract.visualLanguage: Concept signal: verbs pulse, oscillate, accumulate, trace; motifs beat stamp, pendulum, stacked strata, drawn path; one dominant figure per composition over a quiet ground.
contract.formLanguage: Forms follow the hero generator of each composition; the structure layer keeps one module and one grid.
contract.materialLanguage: Light on a dark ground: lamp, signal; pendulum, wave.
contract.colorLogic: complement scheme, OKLCH hue 60 (sodium yellow against dark asphalt); one accent used for events only.
contract.spatialLogic: Canvas 540x1920 (led); the hero sits on the focal zone, structure on the grid, information at the edge.
contract.motionLanguage: Profile: smooth, eased; springy (zeta 0.7624, 2% overshoot); with a wind-up dip before each hit; 16 move(s) per loop of 4 bar(s), so the loop closes. Played as layer.mod spring curves (scripts/motion_profiles.py).
contract.typographyLanguage: Uppercase, one family; text only when the brief supplies exact words.
contract.temporalArc: a figure that returns to where it began; on every beat; over 4 bars per composition, the set follows establish, turn, turn.
contract.loopGrammar: cyclic: the loop closes on whole bars and every layer moves in whole cycles
contract.technicalStrategy: Generated without AI by brief_to_project.py from the structured brief; native pixels, deterministic seed, engine generators only.
contract.forbiddenShortcuts: Do not stretch 16:9 across another aspect; no unseeded randomness; no effect without a reason in the contract.
contract.focalEvent: One dominant figure per composition; everything else supports or releases it.
contract.releaseZone: The ground field and the empty third of the frame; no layer fills it.
contract.banned: shockwave rings on every hit; particle bursts; neon glow everywhere

artBible.thesis: Faixas e palavras gritadas em uma torre estreita de LED, como sinal de rua à noite.
artBible.material: Light on a dark ground (urban, aggressive); lamp, signal; pendulum, wave; no fake materials, no gradients that pretend to be objects.
artBible.space: Read from far away: heavy strokes, large forms, the hero on the focal third, information at the edge.
artBible.motion: Profile: smooth, eased; springy (zeta 0.7624, 2% overshoot); with a wind-up dip before each hit; 16 move(s) per loop of 4 bar(s), so the loop closes. Played as layer.mod spring curves (scripts/motion_profiles.py).
artBible.dramaturgy: a figure that returns to where it began; on every beat; over 4 bars per composition, the set follows establish, turn, turn. Tension: assertive; one dominant figure per composition; the ground field is the release.
artBible.color: complement scheme, OKLCH hue 60 (sodium yellow against dark asphalt); one accent used for events only.
artBible.typography: Uppercase, one family, exact words from the brief only; a calm hierarchy: title, caption at 0.4x, data at 0.16x; revealed by glyph on the build and cleared before the loop ends.
artBible.audio: Strategy full: the music drives most layers; the instrument layer shows the signal.
artBible.banned: shockwave rings on every hit; particle bursts; neon glow everywhere

compositions.name: URBAN I
compositions.hypothesis: ESTABLISH: Faixas e palavras gritadas em uma torre estreita de LED, como sinal de rua à noite.

layers.name: FUNDO
layers.role: ground colour of the piece; the quiet reference everything else is read against

layers.name: CAMPO URBAN I
layers.role: ground field: slow matter that gives the figure something to cut against

layers.name: ATMOSFERA I
layers.role: atmosphere: a second, fainter field in the accent that adds depth without competing with the hero

layers.name: HERÓI URBAN I
layers.role: hero: the single dominant figure of this composition (the focal event)

layers.name: ESTRUTURA I
layers.role: structure: the grid or rhythm the eye measures the hero against

layers.name: INSTRUMENTO I
layers.role: instrument: shows the real signal that drives the picture (cause and effect)

layers.name: PALAVRA I
layers.role: event: the exact words, one per phase, large and few

layers.name: ACABAMENTO
layers.role: finish: vignette and a touch of tension; scanlines only where the surface is a screen
